note: Invented: decisions for a pottery studio's autumn plan.

cards.question: Which glaze set should the autumn class use?
cards.why: The order has to go in by Friday to arrive before the first lesson.
cards.prompt: Decision d1: Marta chose the cone 6 satin set. Order it and add it to the supplies list.

ack.text: Ordered 12 kg of the satin set. It arrives on the 28th and is on the supplies list.

cards.question: Open the studio on Sunday mornings?
cards.why: Two members asked for it. A volunteer would have to unlock and close.
cards.prompt: Decision d2: Marta said yes to Sunday mornings from November.

ack.text: Drafted the rota with two volunteers. Who holds the second key?

cards.question: Keep the old wheel or replace it?
cards.why: The motor runs hot after an hour. A new wheel is quoted at 640.
cards.prompt: Decision d3: Marta wants the wheel replaced next spring.

cards.question: Print the spring workshop flyers in colour?
cards.why: Colour costs three times as much as black and white.
